finding: A semantic or textual match to M-004, M-005, or M-006 is not evidence that a source originated that identifier. Origin requires an immutable source object that explicitly assigns the exact identifier and agrees on namespace, owner, semantic role, and temporal precedence.

claim_classes.observed: The queue requires locating the originating source that assigned M-004, M-005, and M-006, while prior work already rejects namespace collisions and lead-only automation prose.
claim_classes.inferred: Without an explicit identifier-assignment requirement, a semantically similar artifact could be promoted from supporting context to false historical origin.
claim_classes.proposed: Use the identifier-origin evidence schema as a fail-closed promotion boundary for every provenance-gap node.
claim_classes.superseded: Identifier text occurrence or semantic similarity is sufficient to establish origin.
claim_classes.unresolved: No immutable originating object for M-004, M-005, or M-006 was located in the bounded sources inspected during this run. Exhaustive branch and reachable-history coverage remains outstanding.

falsification_route: Produce an immutable object predating later references that explicitly assigns the exact identifier.
Demonstrate namespace, owner, semantic-role, and temporal-precedence agreement.
Show that a rejected collision candidate actually contains explicit origin language rather than a suffix or semantic match.
Complete authenticated ref inventory and reachable-history traversal and retain a coverage receipt.

privacy_boundary.rule: Private chat-history or File Library material may contribute only redacted locator-level evidence unless publication is separately authorized.
